description: The checkout-worker payment event consumer fell behind in production ca-central-1.
issue_summary: At capture, payments-events consumer lag was 18,400 messages, the oldest event was 940 seconds old, and only 3 of 8 expected consumers were active.
trigger_summary: The 18,400-message lag exceeded the documented 5,000-message threshold. The alert requires lag above that threshold for 10 minutes; this snapshot does not include the time series needed to independently verify that duration.
log_summary: Consumer startup configuration validation errors increased after revision 8f31. No secret values or customer identifiers included.

events.message: Consumer startup configuration validation failed after revision 8f31.
Consumer process exited during startup; restart scheduled.
Active consumer count below expected replica count.
